mathematical_definition: (c_t - level_t) / c_t, where level is the price-level state of a hand-rolled 2-state (level, velocity) constant-velocity local-level Kalman filter (features.kalman.kalman_local_level, q=1e-5, r=1.0) -- normalized distance from the adaptive trend
numerical_stability_notes: Filter state initialized to level[0]=price[0], velocity[0]=0, so kalman_level_dist[0]=0 exactly rather than NaN
missing_value_policy: Defined from the first bar (Kalman state seeded with price[0]); never NaN unless the input close itself is NaN
